decisions.intent: How do I get to Troy (site and museum) and Assos from Istanbul or Çanakkale, what are the seasonal hours and tickets, and how do I combine them in winter or summer?
decisions.reason: Scan items: HDN 2026-11-04 (Troy Museum +32.9%, three sites 860,834 visitors, +32.2% in Jan–Sep 2026) and HDN 2026-10-23 (new finds at Troy). Evergreen-but-timely visitor question with no existing coverage; ministry pages (ktb.gov.tr, turkishmuseums.com portal), GoTürkiye and KGM opened for hours, fees, distances and access.

semanticReview.whyDifferent: No existing body covers Troy, Assos, Çanakkale or Gallipoli access; Troy appears only in passing lists (turkiye-tourism-2026). turkiye-museum-site-fees-2027 covers national fees and passes without Troy/Assos prices and is linked rather than repeated; the private itinerary guide's Aegean section covers Ephesus/Şirince only. Pending (unmerged) winter-hours article of 2026-11-02 explicitly omits Troy times. Independent subagent overlap review: distinct.

decisions.intent: How should UK, Irish and German travellers book summer 2027 flights to Bodrum, Dalaman, Antalya or İzmir now that Ryanair has no Türkiye flights on sale and capacity is shifting?
decisions.reason: Scan items: Ryanair Bodrum/Dalaman exit reports (Turizm Ekonomi, Sözcü 2026-10-30), AJet Germany routes (HDN 2026-10-21), DHMİ-based flight declines (Turizm Ekonomi 2026-10-14), minister's WTM 2027 fare/booking forecast (2026-11-05). DHMİ passenger data opened as primary. Article distinguishes confirmed/reported/forecast; booking logistics only.

semanticReview.whyDifferent: The Riviera guide chooses a coast and only lists airport codes; the Belek article covers the AYT transfer and sports-equipment rules; the month-by-month guide covers weather and crowds. No article covers carriers, Ryanair's absence, via-Istanbul connections or booking timing for 2027. Independent subagent overlap review: distinct; links to those guides instead of repeating them.
